confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages; no web sources were used for the city anchors. Food and drink anchors are moderately grounded in general Helsinki price levels, with beer taken as a standard restaurant draft serving of roughly 0.4 L. Cocktail and wine were anchored to the beer relationship (about two times and about 1.6 times the beer anchor) because direct knowledge of local bar prices is weak, so they are less certain. Hostel and hotel anchors reflect July peak-season demand and carry wider uncertainty than the food and drink anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single priced comparable was used. Restaurant and cafe levels were placed alongside other Nordic capitals such as Stockholm and Copenhagen; accommodation reflects Helsinki's high summer demand rather than a national or regional average.
